problem_type: A task progress gate reads a retired document address instead of the canonical plan
symptom: A tagged legacy phase commit cannot satisfy the staged progress check even when its matching row is completed in the actual plan.
direct_cause: PLAN_PATH used docs/plans (already absent before this migration); the actual source is now docs/archive/plan/2026-05-25-phase-e2-completion-and-tech-uplift.md.
class_root: The single commit-msg boundary was not aligned with the owned canonical progress-plan location.
affected_population: E.2C task-tagged commits for any task row
Manual invocation of the progress checker over a staged change
entry_points: direct checker invocation with a message file
internal_only_reason: This is a repository-owned document and Git hook path, decided by the tracked migration rather than external library behavior.
invariants: Every E.2C task uses the same canonical plan staged diff.
Only a staged added completion for the exact tagged row satisfies the check.
generality_proof: The one PLAN_PATH read boundary feeds the staged diff for every task ID. Real temporary Git repositories exercise two different admitted task IDs and reject a different row and unstaged completion. The test also requires the actual canonical source to exist.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Select the single canonical progress document for all tagged invocations.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The installed pipeline invokes check-progress-update.cjs and passes the message filename.
Tests invoke this same script with distinct tagged messages in real Git repositories.

recurrence.reason: Every tagged row or subsequent commit can encounter the same retired path; observing it in an old phase does not make it one-off.
same_class_scan: rg check-progress-update scripts: install-git-hooks.cjs is the sole installed entry and the CLI is separately callable.
node scripts/door-map.mjs PLAN_PATH --roots=scripts --include-tests: 493 files, one read door and three same-file uses.
Direct temporary-Git tests cover E.2C-01 and E.2C-02 and reject unstaged/different-row completion.

prevention.invariant: The one owned document constant selects the canonical archived plan for all matching commits.
prevention.failure_mode: A missing or unmatched staged completion still exits 1; no old-path fallback or bypass is introduced.
prevention.strategy: Align the sole path boundary to the archived owner and characterize actual staged Git behavior across task rows.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed the retired docs/plans lookup from the script; the previously absent directory is not recreated.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency upgrade owns this repository filename; existing Node/Git invocation is retained.

migration: Only the canonical lookup changes. Archived source content and prior progress states are preserved; no task is newly marked complete.
residual_risks: This is the legacy E.2C task gate only; it does not prove current product or deployment behavior.
